verdict.rationale: Cal.com ships a full REST API v2 with auth via API key/OAuth, CLI recommendation for headless agents, a public booking endpoint requiring no auth for agent use, and explicit docs (cal.com/docs/agents.md) describing headless automation patterns for AI agents/CI; self-hosting is also confirmed to work via probe evidence. missing for 10: independent third-party CI pipeline case study, and community friction around self-hosted API/docker reliability (comm-3, comm-4, comm-11) tempers confidence slightly.
